title: Relocat Rights Map authorities file
description: Raw experience reports never enter git; only aggregates with n >= 5 are committed (COMMUNITY_MIN_REPORTS). Community ranges are interquartile ranges (25th-75th percentile), never min-max.

id.description: Unique, stable key of the authority, for example de-sh-stadt-kiel.

covers.description: Districts this authority decides for, as 5-digit AGS keys of the district layer. A district is covered by one authority only.

covers_label.description: The coverage in words, shown to readers.

times.description: The three time figures of the authority, in months.

community.description: Summary of user-reported times. Generated, not edited by hand.

evidence.description: The sources the figures rely on; time figures refer to them by id.

value.description: Short code of how to apply (online, appointment, paper, waiting_list), or null when unknown.

src.description: Kind of source behind the statement.

date.description: When the source was published, or read if it is undated.

wait.description: Months before the authority starts processing.

src.description: Kind of source; none means no figure is known.

hi.description: Upper bound in months; omit when the source gives one number. Not below lo.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM, of the source or of the day it was read. An official figure older than 12 months is stale.

note.description: How the source was read; caveats.

partial.description: True when the source gives only a lower limit (more than lo months).

stale_exempt.description: True for an official figure that cannot go out of date.

n.description: Number of reports behind a community figure; at least 5 to be published.

range.description: For a community figure, iqr: the 25th to 75th percentile.

evidence.description: Ids of the evidence entries of this authority that support the figure; required for official.

n.description: Number of reports. Figures are published only from 5 reports.

range.description: iqr: the 25th to 75th percentile, never min-max.

kind.description: Kind of source. official needs a url; press needs via.

text.description: The passage the figure comes from, quoted or paraphrased briefly.

date.description: Publication date, or the day an undated page was read.

url.description: Link to the source; must start with https://.

via.description: Outlet and date when someone else reports the source.
